history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Calculations:
- Per-file size from overage: 100GB / 60 = 1.6667 GB per file (approx).
- Total files: 60 + 980 = 1040 files.
- Total required storage: 1040 × 1.6667 ≈ 1733.3 GB ≈ 1.73 TB.
- Minimum plan sufficient: Plus (2 TB) since Standard has 0 GB and 2 TB ≥ 1.73 TB.
- Monthly cost difference: $40 − $10 = $30.
- Which files are over the current plan limit? Standard has 0 GB usable storage; effectively all 1040 files go over the limit.
- Average additional cost per over-limit file: $30 / 1040 ≈ $0.02885 → rounded to nearest cent = 0.03.
Candidate answer: 0.03. I propose we confirm minor unit assumptions, then finalize.
